before: A vertical merge whose rows can split and that crosses a page break sizes its head row to the whole merged text and moves the other rows below it.
after: The merge keeps each row at its own height on its page and continues the merged text beside the rows on the next page.
reason: The change only derives layout rows and continuation cursors for page fragments. Canonical OOXML, source offsets, replicated operations, and awareness messages remain unchanged.
